scripts.install:all: cd electron-core-ui && npm install && cd ../gitable && npm install && cd ../demo && npm install && cd ../restorm && npm install
scripts.dev:gitable: cd gitable && npx cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 npx electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:demo: cd demo && npx cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 npx electron-vite dev
scripts.dev:restorm: cd restorm && npx cross-env ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 npx electron-vite dev
scripts.build:gitable: cd gitable && npm install ../electron-core-ui && npm run build
scripts.build:demo: cd demo && npm install ../electron-core-ui && npm run build
scripts.build:restorm: cd restorm && npm install ../electron-core-ui && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build:core-ui && npm run build:gitable && npm run build:demo && npm run build:restorm
scripts.lint: cd gitable && npm run lint && cd ../demo && npm run lint && cd ../restorm && npm run lint && cd ../electron-core-ui && npm run lint
